name: Somnath Temple
why: The first of the twelve Jyotirlingas, standing on the Arabian Sea shore.

name: Mallikarjuna Swamy Temple
why: A rare temple that is both a Jyotirlinga and a Shakti Peetha, in the Nallamala hills.

name: Mahakaleshwar Temple
why: Famous for the dawn Bhasma Aarti in the ancient city of Ujjain.

name: Omkareshwar Temple
why: A Jyotirlinga on an Om-shaped island in the Narmada river.

name: Kedarnath Temple
why: A Himalayan Jyotirlinga at 3,500 m, reached by a sacred trek.

name: Bhimashankar Temple
why: A forest Jyotirlinga in the Sahyadri hills, source of the Bhima river.

name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
why: The heart of Kashi, with the Ganga Aarti at the ghats nearby.

name: Trimbakeshwar Temple

name: Baidyanath Dham

name: Grishneshwar Temple

name: Dwarkadhish Temple

name: Jagannath Temple

name: Yamunotri Temple

name: Gangotri Temple

name: Sri Venkateswara Temple, Tirumala

name: Mata Vaishno Devi

name: Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple)

name: Meenakshi Amman Temple

name: Kamakhya Temple

name: Kalighat Kali Temple

name: Dakshineswar Kali Temple

name: Belur Math

name: Shree Siddhivinayak Temple

name: Shirdi Sai Baba Samadhi Mandir

name: Vitthal Rukmini Temple

name: Mahalakshmi Temple

name: Sabarimala Ayyappa Temple

name: Guruvayur Sri Krishna Temple

name: Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple

name: Brihadeeswarar Temple

name: Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple

name: Kamakshi Amman Temple

name: Arunachaleswarar Temple

name: Palani Murugan Temple

name: Kumari Amman Temple

name: Chamundeshwari Temple

name: Mahabaleshwar Temple

name: Sri Manjunatha Temple

name: Srikalahasteeswara Temple

name: Simhachalam Temple

name: Mahabodhi Temple

name: Naina Devi Temple

name: Ambaji Temple

name: Shrinathji Temple

name: Brahma Temple

name: Khatu Shyam Ji Temple

name: Salasar Balaji Temple

name: Swaminarayan Akshardham
why: A vast carved-stone temple with exhibitions on Indian culture.
